notes.title: Update information（12.5.2022）
notes.content:
An update for "遊んで将棋が強くなる！ 銀星将棋DX2" has been delivered.
The contents of this update are as follows.

[h3]Content updated in this version[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that the volume set as an option is not reflected when the game is restarted.
[/list]
Thank you for your continued support of "遊んで将棋が強くなる！ 銀星将棋DX2".

notes.title: About problems related to volume adjustment（19.4.2022）
notes.content:
Thank you for using "遊んで将棋が強くなる！ 銀星将棋DX2".

We have confirmed a phenomenon in which the volume set in the options is not reflected when starting the game for the second time or later after the game data is saved.
We apologize for the inconvenience.

We are currently investigating this issue and will inform you as soon as there is progress.

Thank you for your understanding.
[hr][/hr] ↓
※May 12, 2022 An update for this matter was delivered.
